messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on streaming-inference-us-west-2 (service: streaming-runner). p95 jumped >2x, p99 >4x over baseline. Paging oncall_sre. Severity: P2.

oncall_sre: I'm on it. Observed customer-facing errors?

support-eng: Several streaming sessions reported stalls and reconnects. Support ticket count up ~8 in last 10m; most impacted are Dedicated customers in us-west.

eng-infra-lead: Looking at infra metrics — one GPU node (gpu-az2-n12) shows repeated correctable ECC events + thermal throttle messages. Node saw a sustained temp bump ~15m ago. Could be causing KV stall/streaming tail.

ml-runtime: p95 went from 750ms to ~1.9s across the cluster segment hitting that rack, p99 from ~3s to ~11-13s. Streaming stall rate + queue backlog visible in runtime traces.

alex: grabbing node logs now. running: ```kubectl describe node gpu-az2-n12``` and ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,ecc.errors.uncorrected,ecc.errors.corrected --format=csv -l 1 -f```

maya: I can start moving traffic at the routing layer to other AZs/variants — prefer warm fallback model (small-quant) to avoid complete session drops. That will increase token cost but reduce tail latency.

oncall_sre: Priorities: 1) stop customer impact, 2) reduce tail latency ASAP, 3) root cause. Immediate mitigations: - drain the node, - enable fallback routing to small-quant & alternate region, - bump autoscale on dedicated pool.

eng-infra-lead: Agreed. Ty for plan. I'm initiating drain + cordon on gpu-az2-n12. Command: ```kubectl cordon gpu-az2-n12 && kubectl drain gpu-az2-n12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force```

incident-bot: NOTE: Runbook step triggered: "Drain suspected GPU node" by eng-infra-lead.

alex: journal snippets: ```Mar 25 14:02:41 gpu-az2-n12 kernel: Corrected ECC error on GPU0, count=5
Mar 25 14:05:02 gpu-az2-n12 runtime: thermal_throttle: GPU temp spike detected, throttling engaged
Mar 25 14:07:13 gpu-az2-n12 runtime: kv-cache miss spikes; stream stall observed for session <redacted>```

ml-runtime: We need to clear KV hot-shards that were pinned to that node. Suggest moving primary ownership for those shards. Running handoff: ```rtr-shard-hand-off --shard-id=usw2-45 --from=gpu-az2-n12 --to=gpu-az1-n03```

eng-infra-lead: Hand-off started. Also raising capacity in other pools: ```redwoodctl scale pool dedicated-usw2-gpu --replicas +3 --priority emergency```

support-eng: Messaging internal support: "Customers in us-west may see transient reconnections and elevated latency; team is mitigating, ETA 20-40m" :email: (sent).

prod-eng: Can we flip the fallback policy in Console so SDK/Hosted requests route to quantized variant when p99 > 2s? If so, do it.

maya: Doing it now. Toggled fallback -> model-x-small-quant in routing policy for us-west. Incident-bot: config-change recorded.

incident-bot: NOTE: "Routing policy altered: fallback model enabled for streaming-inference-us-west-2" by maya.

oncall_sre: After drain began, we see node staging out of load. Observed immediate reduction in CPU-blocks but p99 still high, likely due to queued sessions and shard handoffs.

ml-runtime: Started dropping new long-polling sessions to fallback route; streaming sessions are reconnecting and getting quantized model — quality tradeoff but latency now falling. p95 ~900ms, p99 ~2.6s and trending down.

alex: nvidia-smi confirms temps dropping after cordon; corrected ECC error rate still elevated (total corrected count ~180 in 1h). Suspect flaky memory channel on GPU0. 

eng-infra-lead: We're going to quarantine gpu-az2-n12 for hardware replacement. Ticketing hw-lab and scheduling swap. For now mark node as quarantined in inventory: ```hw-inv mark gpu-az2-n12 quarantined```

oncall_sre: Customer impact update: support-eng to CC affected customers with note: mitigation in progress, reduced latency with fallback; dedicated customers may see degraded output quality if routed to quantized. ETA for full recovery 2-4h depending on hardware swap.

support-eng: Posted interim status to affected customers and internal status page.

ml-runtime: Regression alert flagged for model-x-small-quant vs primary; alerting evals-team to monitor quality drift and roll back if unacceptable.

prod-eng: Can we also enable cross-region routing for active sessions (sticky sessions complicate this)? If not fully possible, at minimum route new sessions to other regions.

maya: New sessions now routed to us-east-1 warm pool. Sticky sessions will remain for a bit; runtime will attempt graceful reconnection.

alex: Capturing additional artifacts for postmortem: ```dmesg | grep -i ecc > /tmp/gpu-ecc-9776.log``` and runtime traces for sessions: `/var/tmp/stream-traces/9776543210/*`

eng-infra-lead: Post-mitigation checklist: - confirm node replacement done, - validate corrected ECC counters drop after swap, - run thermal soak test on replacement, - follow up on rack cooling metrics. Assign eng-infra-lead & oncall_sre.

noncall_sre: Monitoring: p95 back to baseline (~760ms) after 25m, p99 settled ~1.2s. We'll keep this thread open until node is out of rotation and replacement verified.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION NOTE: Mitigation applied (drain + fallback + shard handoff). Severity de-escalated to P3. Manual review required.

prod-eng: Filing incident with short description for postmortem: "GPU node hardware ECC/thermal caused streaming p99 spike; live mitigations: drain, fallback routing to quantized model, shard handoff, scale-up of warm pool." Assign to eng-infra-lead.

support-eng: ETA update to customers: hardware swap scheduled in next maintenance window (~3h). We'll provide an update after swap.

maya: adding a temporary routing health-check to catch similar spikes faster (alert when p99>2s for 3m).

alex: saving logs to S3: ```aws s3 cp /tmp/gpu-ecc-9776.log s3://redwood-incidents/9776543210/```

noncall_sre: Leaving oncall notes: actions taken, commands run, contacts for hardware team and follow-ups. Marking ticket in PagerDuty as "acknowledged -> mitigated".

eng-infra-lead: Thank you team. We'll run the postmortem after hardware verified. Closing this thread in 6h if no regressions. :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:, monitoring continues.

support-eng: Closing customer notices thread after hardware swap confirmation.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (will remain archived)"
